bibl.title: Overview of Extracellular Vesicles, Their Origin, Composition, Purpose, and Methods for Exosome Isolation and Analysis

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: extracellular vesicles - microvesicles, exosomes and apoptotic bodies - and the methods used to isolate and analyse them
span.quote: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are lipid bound vesicles secreted by cells into the extracellular space \ [1, 2\]. The three main subtypes of EVs are microvesicles (MVs), exosomes, and apoptotic bodies, which are differentiated based upon their biogenesis, release pathways, size, content, and function

span.label: how the subtypes of extracellular vesicle differ, and whether the isolation and analysis methods in use can tell them apart
span.quote: Despite their promising potential, the use of exosomes in the clinical setting is restricted due to the lack of standardization in exosome isolation and analysis methods.

span.label: a review that names the field's category boundary as unmeasurable: the three EV subtypes are defined by biogenesis, no protein marker distinguishes them, and the profile that is measured depends on the isolation method used
span.quote: While no specific protein markers have been identified to distinguish between the different types of EVs, MVs, exosomes, and apoptotic bodies have different protein profiles due to their different routes of formation \ [9, 10, 11\]. However, substantial overlap of protein profiles is often observed, due in part to the lack of standardized isolation and analysis methods of EVs

span.label: critique
span.quote: Despite their promising potential, the use of exosomes in the clinical setting is restricted due to the lack of standardization in exosome isolation and analysis methods.

span.label: lipid-bound vesicles secreted by cells into the extracellular space, carrying lipids, nucleic acids and proteins
span.quote: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are lipid bound vesicles secreted by cells into the extracellular space \ [1, 2\]. The three main subtypes of EVs are microvesicles (MVs), exosomes, and apoptotic bodies, which are differentiated based upon their biogenesis, release pathways, size, content, and function

span.label: narrative review of isolation methods - ultracentrifugation, size, immunoaffinity capture, precipitation - and of the analysis methods applied to their output
span.term: narrative review of isolation methods - ultracentrifugation, size, immunoaffinity capture, precipitation - and of the analysis methods applied to their output
span.quote: Exosomes were originally isolated by ultracentrifugation-based methods, and while these methods remain the gold standard, other methods have been developed to address the challenges associated with ultracentrifugation

span.label: exosomes form by inward budding of the limiting membrane of early endosomes, which mature into multivesicular bodies; the MVB is then either degraded in the lysosome or fused with the plasma membrane to release its contents
span.quote: Exosomes are a subtype of EV formed by an endosomal route and are typically 30–150 nm in diameter \ [1, 3, 4, 5\]. Specifically, exosomal vesicles form by inward budding of the limiting membrane of early endosomes, which mature into multivesicular bodies (MVBs) during the process

span.label: the fate of a particular MVB depends on its cholesterol level - a cholesterol-rich vesicle was secreted while a MORPHOLOGICALLY IDENTICAL vesicle lacking cholesterol was degraded
span.quote: However, studies have been done to demonstrate that the fate of a particular MVB depends on the level of cholesterol in the MVB. Specifically, a cholesterol rich vesicle was secreted while a morphologically identical vesicle that lacked cholesterol was sent to the lysosome for degradation

span.label: MVB and exosome formation are regulated through the ESCRT pathway, and the ESCRT proteins expected in every exosome are what the field calls `exosomal marker proteins` - the markers are derived from the biogenesis story rather than measured against it
span.quote: Because exosomal formation and MVB transportation are regulated by ESCRT proteins, these proteins and its accessory proteins (Alix, TSG101, HSC70, and HSP90β) are expected to be found in exosomes regardless of the type of cell from which they originate \ [10, 47, 48, 49, 50\]. Thus, this set of proteins are often termed “exosomal marker proteins.”

span.label: THE INSTRUMENT DETERMINES THE OBJECT, DEMONSTRATED AND STATED PLAINLY: `it has been demonstrated that DIFFERENT ISOLATION METHODS used to isolate exosomes FROM THE SAME CELL TYPE results in DIFFERENT PROTEOMIC PROFILES, further complicating the situation`. Same cells, different machine, different answer about what the cells secreted.
span.quote: it has been demonstrated that different isolation methods used to isolate exosomes from the same cell type results in different proteomic profiles, further complicating the situation

span.label: AND THE PROPOSED REPAIR IS TO RELATIVISE THE DEFINITION TO THE INSTRUMENT: `INSTEAD OF focusing on establishing a set of exosomal/non exosomal marker proteins secreted by all cell types INDEPENDENT OF THE ISOLATION METHOD, it may be more beneficial to focus on ... a set of exosomal/non exosomal marker proteins for all exosomes, regardless of their origin, WHEN ISOLATED BY A SPECIFIC METHOD.` Having found that the method changes the object, the review does not propose a better method - it proposes DEFINING THE OBJECT RELATIVE TO THE METHOD.
span.quote: Therefore, instead of focusing on establishing a set of exosomal/non exosomal marker proteins secreted by all cell types independent of the isolation method, it may be more beneficial to focus on the development of exosomal/non exosomal marker proteins for a given cell type, independent of isolation method, or a set of exosomal/non exosomal marker proteins for all exosomes, regardless of their origin, when isolated by a specific method

span.label: AND THE UNSOLVED PROBLEM IS NAMED AS A DIFFERENTIATION PROBLEM, NOT A PURITY ONE: `the challenge remains to develop isolation techniques that CAN DIFFERENTIATE THE DIFFERENT TYPES OF EVs in the extracellular matrix and do so rapidly, efficiently, reproducibly, and in a clinically friendly manner`. Four adverbs, and the paper elsewhere says combining methods buys purity at the cost of three of them.
span.quote: Thus, the challenge remains to develop isolation techniques that can differentiate the different types of EVs in the extracellular matrix and do so rapidly, efficiently, reproducibly, and in a clinically friendly manner

span.label: THE CLASS BOUNDARY CANNOT BE DRAWN WITH WHAT IS MEASURED: no specific protein marker distinguishes the EV subtypes, and substantial overlap of profiles is observed
span.quote: While no specific protein markers have been identified to distinguish between the different types of EVs, MVs, exosomes, and apoptotic bodies have different protein profiles due to their different routes of formation \ [9, 10, 11\]. However, substantial overlap of protein profiles is often observed, due in part to the lack of standardized isolation and analysis methods of EVs

span.label: THE MEASUREMENT PARTLY MAKES THE OBJECT: proteomic profiles of EVs from the SAME SOURCE depend on which isolation method was used
span.quote: Further, it has been demonstrated that the proteomic profiles of EVs from the same source are dependent on their isolation method

span.label: every isolation method, including the alternatives to the gold standard, fails to isolate exosomes exclusively and yields complex mixtures of EVs and other extracellular material
span.quote: These alternative methods have been developed based on isolation by size, immunoaffinity capture, and precipitation of exosomes, however, even these methods fail to exclusively isolate exosomes, and typically result in complex mixtures of EVs and other components of the extracellular space

span.label: the reasons isolation fails are the complexity of the biological fluid, the drastic overlap of physiochemical properties between exosomes and other EVs, AND the heterogeneity among exosomes themselves
span.quote: This is due to the complexity of biological fluids from which exosomes are being isolated from, the drastic overlap in the physiochemical and biochemical properties between exosomes and different EVs, and the heterogeneity among exosomes themselves

span.label: the factors determining whether an MVB is secreted or degraded are stated to be not well understood, in the paragraph that describes the mechanism
span.quote: MVBs are eventually either sent to the lysosome to be degraded along with all of its components or fused with the cell’s plasma membrane to release its content, including exosomes, into the extracellular space \ [4, 40, 41, 42\]. The factors that determine the fate of a specific MVB are not well understood

span.label: THE REFERENCE METHOD KEEPS ITS TITLE AFTER THE PAPER WITHDRAWS ITS WARRANT: `while these methods REMAIN THE GOLD STANDARD, other methods have been developed to address the challenges associated with ultracentrifugation` - and two sentences later NO method, ultracentrifugation included, isolates exosomes exclusively. `gold standard` here marks incumbency, not demonstrated accuracy.
span.quote: Exosomes were originally isolated by ultracentrifugation-based methods, and while these methods remain the gold standard, other methods have been developed to address the challenges associated with ultracentrifugation

span.label: THE FIELD'S OWN NAMED OBSTACLE IS AGREEMENT, NOT TECHNIQUE: `a major hindrance in bringing exosomes into the clinical setting is the LACK OF STANDARDIZATION in isolation methods`. The barrier to the clinic is stated as a coordination failure among laboratories.
span.quote: a major hindrance in bringing exosomes into the clinical setting is the lack of standardization in isolation methods

span.label: protein profiles of EVs from the SAME SOURCE are compared across isolation methods
span.note: eliminates: a difference produced by the isolation procedure being reported as a difference between vesicle populations · outcome: failed
span.quote: Further, it has been demonstrated that the proteomic profiles of EVs from the same source are dependent on their isolation method

span.label: a cholesterol-rich MVB is compared with a MORPHOLOGICALLY IDENTICAL cholesterol-poor one
span.note: eliminates: morphology being credited with a fate that composition determines · outcome: held
span.quote: However, studies have been done to demonstrate that the fate of a particular MVB depends on the level of cholesterol in the MVB. Specifically, a cholesterol rich vesicle was secreted while a morphologically identical vesicle that lacked cholesterol was sent to the lysosome for degradation

span.label: exosome - AS DEFINED HERE: a subtype of EV formed BY AN ENDOSOMAL ROUTE, typically 30-150 nm - the definition is by ORIGIN, and origin is not what any assay observes
span.quote: Exosomes are a subtype of EV formed by an endosomal route and are typically 30–150 nm in diameter \ [1, 3, 4, 5\]. Specifically, exosomal vesicles form by inward budding of the limiting membrane of early endosomes, which mature into multivesicular bodies (MVBs) during the process

span.label: exosomal marker proteins - the ESCRT proteins and accessories (Alix, TSG101, HSC70, HSP90beta) EXPECTED to be present because of the biogenesis account, and then named as markers
span.quote: Because exosomal formation and MVB transportation are regulated by ESCRT proteins, these proteins and its accessory proteins (Alix, TSG101, HSC70, and HSP90β) are expected to be found in exosomes regardless of the type of cell from which they originate \ [10, 47, 48, 49, 50\]. Thus, this set of proteins are often termed “exosomal marker proteins.”

span.label: gold standard - ultracentrifugation, called that in the same passage that says every method including it yields complex mixtures rather than exosomes
span.quote: Exosomes were originally isolated by ultracentrifugation-based methods, and while these methods remain the gold standard, other methods have been developed to address the challenges associated with ultracentrifugation

span.label: `exosome` CANNOT BE SEPARATED FROM WHAT ISOLATES IT: `even these methods FAIL TO EXCLUSIVELY ISOLATE exosomes, and typically result in COMPLEX MIXTURES of EVs and other components of the extracellular space`. The category is operational, and the operation does not respect the category.
span.quote: These alternative methods have been developed based on isolation by size, immunoaffinity capture, and precipitation of exosomes, however, even these methods fail to exclusively isolate exosomes, and typically result in complex mixtures of EVs and other components of the extracellular space

span.label: AND THE REASON IS THAT THE CATEGORIES OVERLAP IN THE PROPERTIES THE INSTRUMENTS READ: `the DRASTIC OVERLAP in the physiochemical and biochemical properties between exosomes and different EVs, and the HETEROGENEITY AMONG EXOSOMES THEMSELVES`. The boundary is not merely hard to measure; the paper says the measurable properties do not carry it.
span.quote: This is due to the complexity of biological fluids from which exosomes are being isolated from, the drastic overlap in the physiochemical and biochemical properties between exosomes and different EVs, and the heterogeneity among exosomes themselves

span.label: critiques → the EV isolation literature, on the ground that the proteomic profile obtained from one source depends on the method used to obtain it
span.quote: Further, it has been demonstrated that the proteomic profiles of EVs from the same source are dependent on their isolation method

span.label: critiques → the use of exosomes as clinical biomarkers, on the ground that no standardized isolation or analysis method exists
span.quote: Despite their promising potential, the use of exosomes in the clinical setting is restricted due to the lack of standardization in exosome isolation and analysis methods.

span.label: extends → MISEV2018, whose reporting recommendations the review says must be incorporated to improve rigour and reproducibility of identified EV markers
span.quote: Regardless, it is of utmost importance to consider and incorporate the recommendations from the Minimal Information for Studies of Extracellular Vesicles 2018 (MISEV2018) \ [154\] when conducting and reporting EV-related works to improve rigor and reproducibility of identified EV markers.

span.label: builds-on → the Minimal Information for Studies of Extracellular Vesicles 2018 (MISEV2018) reporting guidelines
span.note: The review's last substantive sentence hands the problem it has documented to a reporting standard. MISEV2018 is staged in this corpus as thery2018, so this is a citation between two records we hold.
